items.title: Smallcaps jump 3.6%, PSU banks surge 7.5% as Sensex, Nifty extend weekly gains; what lies ahead?
items.description: Nifty closed at 25,144 after its third straight weekly gain as smallcaps rose 3.6% and PSU banks surged 7.5%. Analysts see support at 24,800–25,000 and resistance at 25,400.
